case_number: 2024 INSC 595; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. [ARISING OUT OF SLP(CRIMINAL) NO. 8781 OF 2024, SLP(CRIMINAL) NO. 8772 OF 2024]
summary: Bail appeal in PMLA; predicate CBI FIR alleging excise policy irregularities; appellant arrested Feb-Mar 2023; charge-sheets filed Apr-May 2023 under PC Act and PMLA; multiple bail denials by trial court, High Court; prior Supreme Court orders (Oct 2023, Jun 2024) noting investigation timelines; voluminous evidence (493+ witnesses, 69k+ pages); ED allegedly concealed exculpatory documents; no change in circumstances warranting bail; trial delay arguments rejected; merit analysis reaffirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.7A, s.8, s.12
Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.420, s.201, s.120B
Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.3
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; bail denied; prior orders refusing bail upheld; no interference with High Court's rejection of bail application.
